defect: GetCharInfo calls memset(charInfo, 0, sizeof(charInfo)) on a pointer, so only pointer-size bytes are zeroed and the struct (e.g. its pad bytes) is not cleared as intended.
reason: The fix's only behavioural change is sizeof(*charInfo) in that memset, a line this new file added (the other hunks are warning-only no-ops); callers that pre-zero mask it, but the line is wrong as written.

defect: The slider label uses the translation key "Refresh Interval" while the same commit renamed the ini key to "Refresh interval", so the lookup misses and the label is never translated.
reason: The fix only corrects the key's case in the line this change wrote; seeing the mismatch needs the lang ini files.

defect: axis() maps a zero axis value to direction +1 only, so a button mapped to the negative direction (e.g. a HAT d-pad left/up) never gets KEY_UP and sticks.
reason: The axis-to-button mapping with value >= 0 ? 1 : -1 was added by this change and the fix processes both directions when the value is 0.

defect: Switching the guard to PPSSPP_ARCH(ARM_NEON) enables the function-pointer assignments on ARM64, where ARM_NEON is also defined and DoQuickTexHash etc. are macros naming the NEON functions, breaking the ARM64 build.
reason: The fix adds && !PPSSPP_ARCH(ARM64) to exactly the line this change edited; seeing it needs ppsspp_config.h and TextureDecoder.h.

defect: For plain ATRAC3 audio the new low-level decode path still allocates and fills a buffer from the uninitialized AT3+ header (huge size, copy of filesize bytes from guest memory) and feeds it to the AT3+ decoder, crashing.
reason: The fix moves the buffer setup added by this change inside the AT3+ branch, and a reader can see the AT3 branch falls through into it.

defect: The switch on sys_info.subsystem uses case WINDOWSYSTEM_DISPLAY (a Vulkan WindowSystem value) instead of SDL_SYSWM_KMSDRM, so KMSDRM is never matched and the value collides with SDL_SYSWM_X11 (duplicate case build error).
reason: The fix replaces that case label, which this change added; the enum mismatch is visible against the other SDL_SYSWM_ cases.

defect: The new status check in scePsmfPlayerGetVideoData returns ERROR_PSMF_NOT_INITIALIZED (and uses isPlayingStatus) where the PSP returns ERROR_PSMFPLAYER_INVALID_STATUS for status < PLAYING.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly the check and error code this change introduced; the correct code is hardware behaviour not derivable from the code.

defect: The new Q_WS_X11 branches include mainwindow.h and build the desktop MainWindow also on X11 GLES2 targets such as Harmattan/MeeGo, which breaks their build.
reason: The fix narrows both guards this change added to Q_WS_X11 && !USING_GLES2; knowing Harmattan is X11 without the desktop UI needs the project files.

defect: sceKernelCancelSema resets to initCount only when newCount == -1, while the PSP does so for any negative newCount, so other negatives set a negative count.
reason: The fix changes == -1 to < 0 in the line this change added; the expected behaviour comes from hardware tests.

defect: The new deviceTimestamps_ write is guarded only by deviceId < DEVICE_ID_COUNT on a 42-element array, so DEVICE_ID_ANY (-1) or DEVICE_ID_TOUCH (42) index out of bounds.
reason: The fix tightens the range check and sizes the array to DEVICE_ID_COUNT, both added by this change; seeing it needs InputState.h and ControlMapper.h.

defect: The new BLACKBERRY branch includes GLES3/gl3.h and gl3ext.h, which lack the NVIDIA extension definitions the code uses, causing build errors on Blackberry.
reason: The fix reverts exactly those three added lines; the missing extensions are only visible in the headers and their users.

defect: Rewind now uses zip_fseek(zf, 0, SEEK_SET), which fails on compressed zip entries (return value ignored), so rewinding silently does nothing and texture packs in compressed zips break.
reason: The fix restores close-and-reopen in place of the zip_fseek this change introduced; the limitation is in libzip, not the diff.

defect: RunPauseAction notifies actionWait even when pauseAction is PAUSE_CONTINUE (no waiter), leaving a stale signal with the event-based condition variable so a later SetPauseAction wait returns before the action ran.
reason: The fix returns without notifying in the CONTINUE case of the function this change added; the effect depends on the native condition_variable implementation.

defect: DrawActiveTexture's new glDrawTextureNV fast path is taken whenever a texture is passed, even with a post-shader program, so post-processing shaders are bypassed on Tegra.
reason: This change moved the NV path into DrawActiveTexture and started passing colorTexture with postShaderProgram_; the fix adds && !program.

defect: The new madd/maddu use MapDirtyDirtyInIn with the default avoidLoad=true, so LO/HI are mapped without loading and SMLAL/UMLAL accumulate onto garbage.
reason: The fix passes avoidLoad=false in the two calls this change added; the default and its meaning are in ArmRegCache.h/.cpp.

defect: The new avoidLoad logic sets MAP_NOINIT whenever avoidLoad is false (overlap = avoidLoad && ...), so avoidLoad=false never loads the destination, the inverse of its meaning.
reason: The fix rewrites the overlap expressions this change added into load = !avoidLoad || overlap; the inversion is readable from the diff.
